_status: Stage 2 STAGED — token-dependent uncertainty (DeltaE) BLOCKED. Splits are policy-only; no held-out data has been touched.

acquisition.primary_status: HTTP 401 — token required, registration is human-mediated
acquisition.secondary_status: available, time-series only, caltech_sessions.json is 2 bytes (empty)
acquisition.audit_method: HTTP GET via urllib; sample of 200 Caltech time-series files via Git Trees API + raw.githubusercontent.com

calibration.rationale: Encloses the historical behavior we use to fit f_hat(omega). Starts at first Caltech data; ends at the 2019-07-01 boundary so the held-out window is 6 full months.

held_out.rationale: 6 calendar months of held-out data, temporally disjoint from calibration.

temporal_split.enforcement: By filename connectionTime AND file first_ts (both confirmed UTC by audit; see STAGE_2 §6). Sessions are assigned by connTime-in-UTC, which is the same instant the scheduler would observe at decision time. DST-aware local conversion is applied only for slot indexing, never for the calibration/held-out split boundary itself.

leakage_rules.1: No session ID (or filename) may appear in both sets.
leakage_rules.2: No parameter (penalty weights, gamma(omega), scenario weights, TOU tariff, cleaning thresholds) may be learned from held-out data.
leakage_rules.3: No realized omega from held-out data may be exposed during schedule construction.
leakage_rules.4: All preprocessing that depends on data statistics (outlier detection, normalization, scenario generation) is fitted only on calibration data.

blocker.needed_for: Stage 1 uncertainty variable DeltaE = kWhDelivered - kWhRequested
blocker.status: NOT ACCESSIBLE without an ACN-Data API token. The static snapshot does not contain userInputs. Until the token arrives, the uncertainty model cannot be finalized and Stage 3 must not begin.
blocker.owner: project owner (registration at https://ev.caltech.edu/register is human-mediated)
blocker.fallback: If the token does not arrive within 2 business days, Stage 1 must be amended per the project rules: either drop DeltaE (substantial paper reframing) or STOP the project.
